title: 第七章 神秘的木桥第八章 忘川寺白银盟主Devin1加更
content_zh:
“东西在背包里面，我们东西都丢掉了。”方雪脸一红，说起来她和俞沐之所以落到这种地步，完全是因为她的缘故。
狄九一皱眉，他没有继续询问俞沐和方雪是怎么出现在这里的。
看见狄九皱眉，方雪连忙说道，“我和俞沐还有另外两个伙伴一起去忘川寺游玩，不知道怎么回事，我突然看见了一条从未见过的木桥。忘川寺我也来过几次，以前是没有这种木桥的。我以为是新景点，就跨上了木桥。没想到我刚刚跨上木桥，就看见了几头灰狼，我吓的赶紧跑……”
俞沐接着方雪的话说道，“我看见方雪跑，我也跟着跑，方雪说有好几条灰狼，我虽然没有看见，心里并没有觉得有假。结果我们一路上将包手机全部跑丢了，现在彻底迷路，这几天都是吃野果和草根，还有几块巧克力。”
“你确实是看见了狼？”狄九有些疑惑，按理说忘川寺既然是景点，那就不可能同时出现几条灰狼啊。
方雪略一犹豫就说道，“当时我肯定看见了，后来我也有些怀疑我是不是看错了。忘川寺在忘川山脉最外围，和忘川山脉危险的地方都是割离开的，怎么会有狼呢？”
“那你们进来几天了？”
“估计有两三天吧，这几天我们一直在逃跑和恐惧当中，具体过了多久也不是特别清楚……”方雪回答了狄九的问题后，犹豫了一下看着狄九问道，“大哥，你也是和我们一样迷路了吗？”
狄九点点头，“没错，我也是迷路了。我叫狄九，以后可以直接叫我名字。这里不远处有一个湖，我们先去湖边住一晚，弄点吃的，然后明天白天继续寻路。”
“啊……”狄九的话刚刚说完，方雪就再次啊了一声，跟着惊恐的说道，“我又看见了木桥，就在那边。”
狄九和俞沐同时向方雪指着的方向看去，哪里有什么桥，方雪指的方向完全是一片荆棘丛。
俞沐也感觉到了不对，脸色苍白起来。她没有看见木桥，却隐约觉得有一道影子消失在荆棘丛所在的方向。
狄九一把抓住方雪的手腕，他立即就感受到了其中的冰凉。狄九拿出一株药材递给方雪，“你将这一株药材嚼碎吞了，俞沐，你帮我看看这张地图。”
原本打算在这里休息一晚上的狄九，此刻已经放弃了打算。他感觉到这里有些诡异，他并不认为方雪突兀之间将荆棘丛看成了木桥。
只要俞沐认识地图上的指向，他宁可连夜赶路。
狄九拿出来的地图是一副平面景图，上面虽然标注了东南西北，可是景图上的森林、悬崖、山谷，狄九是一个都不知道。
“我知道，这片森林过去就是忘川寺……”看见狄九拿出地图，俞沐惊喜叫道。她的惊喜只是持续了很短的时间，就有些失落的说道，“可惜我们没有指南针，只能等到明天再走。”
吞了一株药材的方雪渐渐安定下来，她也跟着说道，“只能休息一天再走了，俞沐没有体力，根本就走不动啊。”
“我有指南针，走不动我背着，必须要现在就走。如果你们不走，我先走了。”狄九拿出指南针，毫不犹豫的说道。
说完后，狄九又拿出了两块干面，递给了方雪和俞沐。

因为他同样看见了木桥的影子，他肯定方雪并不是幻觉。站在这个地方，他始终有一种很不妥的感觉。
“指南针！”俞沐和方雪都激动的盯着狄九手中的指南针，只要有了指南针和地图，他们肯定可以走出去。
“多谢狄大哥了。”尽管和狄九是第一次见面，俞沐也知道，这个时候除了让狄九背她，根本就没有别的办法。至于狄九递给她们的干面，那更是雪中送炭。
狄九背起俞沐，直接走向忘川寺的方向。
背起俞沐，狄九就感受到两团柔软袭来，他心里有了一种惊喜。他惊喜的不是背后的柔软，而是他的体力。
因为不能习武，狄九一直在学习各种科技知识，学习医道，体力自然很差。这次他背起俞沐，并没有感受到多吃力。现在看来，他的体力增强了一倍都不止。狄九低头看了看自己的胸口，他肯定给自己带来变化的，依然是那一枚灰色石块。
难怪自己从那悬崖下爬上来的时候，没感到多少吃力。
“狄大哥你也是旅游来的吗？”周围太过安静，俞沐主动问了一句。
“是的。”狄九随口答了后就不再说话。
见狄九没有说话的兴趣，俞沐和方雪吃完干面后也都不敢再说话。带着一些月光的森林里面，只剩下走路的飒飒之声。
狄九体力比之前好很多，这样连续背着俞沐也感到有些吃不消。
三人一路走走停停，好在一夜并没有发生什么事情。直到第二天早上，一缕清晨的阳光照射下来，三人走出森林，出现在一处山顶上。
“这里还是看不到任何东西啊。”方雪看着远处雾蒙蒙的一片，有些担忧的说道。
俞沐一样看不到任何东西，两人都只能等着狄九说话。尽管她们都知道忘川山脉地图中森林是忘川寺方向，毕竟都没有走过。
狄九此时才开始震撼自己的视力，方雪和俞沐都看不见任何东西，他居然可以模糊看到极远处的几栋隐隐建筑。他肯定之前自己的眼力没有这么强，可见他被那一道淡金色闪电劈中后，对身体的改变是全方位的。
只是当时他刚刚有了改变，就被曲小树带来的消息震惊，然后逃出了济国而已。
……
一离开森林，那种浑身不舒服的感觉就消失的无影无踪。
“这里休息半天，然后继续走路。”一夜时间，狄九早就累的不行。
“狄大哥，谢谢你，如果不是你救我，我肯定会死在忘川山脉里面。”俞沐在狄九背上休息了一晚上，已勉强可以站起来。

狄九笑了笑，“我正好学过一些医，见过这种蛇毒的解毒办法。”
“狄大哥，你是医学院毕业的吗？”方雪有些期待的看着狄九问道，她和俞沐就都是医学院的。但是两人面对那种蛇毒，都束手无策。狄九治疗俞沐的蛇毒，看起来似乎很简单。
......
content_en:
"The things are in the backpack, we have lost all our things." Fang Xue blushed, saying that the reason why she and Yu Mu were in this situation was entirely because of her.
Di Jiuyi frowned. He did not continue to ask how Yu Mu and Fang Xue appeared here.
Seeing Di Jiu frowning, Fang Xue said quickly, "I went to Wangchuan Temple with Yu Mu and two other friends. I don't know what happened, but I suddenly saw a wooden bridge that I had never seen before. I have been to Wangchuan Temple a few times, and there was no such wooden bridge before. I thought it was a new attraction, so I stepped on the wooden bridge. Unexpectedly, I just stepped on the wooden bridge and saw a few gray wolves. I ran away in fear..."
Yu Mu continued what Fang Xue said, "I saw Fang Xue running, and I ran with him. Fang Xue said there were several gray wolves. Although I didn't see them, I didn't feel it was false. As a result, we lost all our bags and mobile phones along the way, and now we are completely lost. We have been eating wild fruits, grass roots, and a few pieces of chocolate these past few days."
"Did you really see a wolf?" Di Jiu was a little confused. Logically speaking, since Wangchuan Temple is a scenic spot, it is impossible for several gray wolves to appear at the same time.
Fang Xue hesitated and said, "I must have seen it at the time, but later I also doubted whether I had seen it wrong. Wangchuan Temple is at the outermost edge of the Wangchuan Mountains, and is separated from the dangerous areas of the Wangchuan Mountains. How can there be wolves?"
"How many days have you been here?"
"I guess it's been two or three days. We have been running away and fearing these past few days. I'm not particularly sure how long it took..." After Fang Xue answered Di Jiu's question, he hesitated and looked at Di Jiu and asked, "Brother, are you as lost as we are?"
Di Jiu nodded, "Yes, I'm lost too. My name is Di Jiu, you can just call me by my name from now on. There is a lake not far from here. Let's go to the lake to stay one night, get some food, and then continue to find the way during the day tomorrow."
"Ah..." As soon as Di Jiu finished speaking, Fang Xue let out an ahhhhhhh again, and then said in horror, "I saw the wooden bridge again, right over there."
Di Jiu and Yu Mu looked at the direction Fang Xue pointed at the same time. There was no bridge anywhere, but the direction Fang Xue pointed was completely a thorn bush.
Yu Mu also felt something was wrong and turned pale. She didn't see the wooden bridge, but she vaguely felt a shadow disappearing in the direction of the thorn bushes.
Di Jiu grabbed Fang Xue's wrist, and he immediately felt the coldness in it. Di Jiu took out a medicinal plant and handed it to Fang Xue, "Chew this medicinal plant and swallow it. Yu Mu, help me look at this map."
Di Jiu, who originally planned to rest here for a night, has given up the plan now. He felt something strange here, and he didn't think that Fang Xue suddenly saw the thorn bush as a wooden bridge.
As long as Yu Mu knew the directions on the map, he would rather travel overnight.
The map Di Jiu took out was a flat landscape. Although the southeast, northwest and northwest were marked on it, Di Jiu didn't know any of the forests, cliffs, or valleys on the landscape.
"I know, this forest used to be Wangchuan Temple..." Seeing Di Jiu take out the map, Yu Mu shouted in surprise. Her surprise only lasted a short time, and she said a little disappointedly, "It's a pity that we don't have a compass, so we can only wait until tomorrow."
Fang Xue gradually calmed down after swallowing a medicinal plant. She also said, "I can only rest for one day before leaving. Yu Mu has no physical strength and cannot walk at all."
"I have a compass. If I can't walk, I'll carry it on my back. I have to leave now. If you don't leave, I'll leave first." Di Jiu took out the compass and said without hesitation.
After finishing speaking, Di Jiu took out two more pieces of dry noodles and handed them to Fang Xue and Yu Mu.
Because he also saw the shadow of the wooden bridge, he was sure that Fang Xue was not hallucinating. Standing in this place, he always felt that something was wrong.
"Compass!" Yu Mu and Fang XueduStaring at the compass in Di Jiu's hand excitedly, as long as they had the compass and map, they would definitely be able to go out.
"Thank you, Brother Di." Even though it was the first time she met Di Jiu, Yu Mu also knew that at this time, there was no other way except to let Di Jiu carry her. As for the dry noodles Di Jiu handed them, it was even more of a timely help.
Di Jiu carried Yu Mu on his back and walked directly in the direction of Wangchuan Temple.
Carrying Yu Mu on his back, Di Jiu felt two soft balls coming over him, and he felt a surprise in his heart. What surprised him was not the softness of his back, but his physical strength.
Because he could not practice martial arts, Di Jiu had been studying various scientific and technological knowledge and medicine, so his physical strength was naturally very poor. This time he carried Yu Mu on his back and didn't feel too strenuous. Now it seems that his physical strength has more than doubled. Di Jiu looked down at his chest. He must have brought about changes in himself, but it was still the gray stone.
No wonder I didn't feel much difficulty when I climbed up from the cliff.
"Brother Di, are you here for tourism too?" Yu Mu took the initiative to ask as the surroundings were too quiet.
"Yes." Di Jiu answered casually and stopped talking.
Seeing that Di Jiu had no interest in talking, Yu Mu and Fang Xue did not dare to speak anymore after eating the dry noodles. In the forest with some moonlight, only the rustling sound of walking is left.
Di Jiu's physical strength was much better than before, and it was a bit too much to carry Yu Mu on his back like this.
The three of them walked and stopped all the way, but fortunately nothing happened overnight. Until the next morning, a ray of early morning sunlight shone down, and the three of them walked out of the forest and appeared on the top of a mountain.
"You still can't see anything here." Fang Xue looked at the foggy area in the distance and said with some worry.
Yu Mu couldn't see anything either, and both of them could only wait for Di Jiu to speak. Although they all know that the forest on the Forgotten Mountains map is in the direction of Forgotten Temple, they have never walked through it after all.
Di Jiu's vision began to be shocked at this moment. Neither Fang Xue nor Yu Mu could see anything. He could actually vaguely see several faint buildings in the distance. He was sure that his eyesight was not so strong before. It can be seen that after he was struck by the light golden lightning, his body changed in all directions.
It was just that he had just changed at that time and was shocked by the news brought by Qu Xiaoshu, and then escaped from Jiguo.
…
As soon as I left the forest, the uncomfortable feeling disappeared without a trace.
"Rest here for half a day, and then continue walking." After one night, Di Jiu was very tired.
"Brother Di, thank you. If you hadn't saved me, I would have died in the Wangchuan Mountains." Yu Mu rested on Di Jiu's back for the whole night and could barely stand up.
Di Jiu smiled and said, "I happen to have studied some medicine and have seen the detoxification method for this kind of snake venom."
"Brother Di, did you graduate from medical school?" Fang Xue looked at Di Jiu expectantly and asked. She and Yu Mu both graduated from medical school. But both of them were helpless in the face of that kind of snake venom. Di Jiu's treatment of Yu Mu's snake venom seemed simple.
